source.note: Recipes, camp kits and crates: ForeverDB addon data (GPL-3.0, credit required). Prices and vendor prices: ForeverDB site data (players' uploads).

Blacksmithing.name: Fiery Plate Gauntlets of the Hidden Technique

Engineering.name: Hyper Deluxe Sniper Rifle Mk XVII
EZ and SAF Field Transporter: Mt. Hyjal

camp.name: Basic Campfire Kit
camp.effect: Builds a basic campfire that allows cooking and the placement of up to 3 additional camp features. Players sitting or crafting nearby for 1 min will gain benefits from other camp features.

camp.name: Journeyman Campfire Kit
camp.effect: Builds a journeyman campfire that allows cooking and the placement of up to 5 additional camp features. Players sitting or crafting nearby for 1 min will gain benefits from other camp features.

camp.name: Expert Campfire Kit
camp.effect: Builds an expert campfire that allows cooking and the placement of up to 10 additional camp features. Players sitting or crafting nearby for 1 min will gain benefits from other camp features.

camp.name: Mana Well
camp.effect: Constructs a mana well that allows you and others sitting nearby to regenerate 10 (below level 24), 15 (levels 24–33), 20 (levels 34–43), 24 (levels 44–53) or 29 (level 54+) Mana every 5 sec, mutually exclusive with Blessing of Wisdom.

camp.name: Sharpening Wheel
camp.effect: Constructs a sharpening wheel that grants you and others sitting nearby 6 (below level 24), 11 (levels 24–37), 20 (levels 38–51) or 34 (level 52+) increased Strength, mutually exclusive with Strength of Earth Totem.

camp.name: Enchanted Lute
camp.effect: Summons an enchanted lute that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 163 Armor, 7 increase to all stats, and 6 increase to all resistances, mutually exclusive with Mark of the Wild.

camp.name: Reagent Bot
camp.effect: Summons a Reagent Bot that allows you and others nearby to purchase reagents.

camp.name: First Aid Kit
camp.effect: Unpacks a first aid kit that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 3 (below level 12), 8 (levels 12–23), 21 (levels 24–35), 34 (levels 36–47), 45 (levels 48–59) or 56 (level 60+) increased Stamina, mutually exclusive with Power Word: Fortitude.

camp.name: Fish Bowl
camp.effect: Places a small fish bowl that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 8% increased stats, mutually exclusive with Blessing of Kings.

camp.name: Incense Candle
camp.effect: Ignites an incense candle that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 2 (below level 14), 6 (levels 14–27), 12 (levels 28–41), 18 (levels 42–55) or 25 (level 56+) increased Intellect, mutually exclusive with Arcane Intellect.

camp.name: Camp Tent
camp.effect: Builds a tent that allows you and others sitting nearby to increase Rested experience to 5% of a level. No effect if Rested experience already exceeds that value.

camp.name: Lodestone
camp.effect: Erects a lodestone that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 12 (below level 12), 20 (levels 12–21), 32 (levels 22–31), 49 (levels 32–41), 67 (levels 42–51) or 90 (level 52+) increased melee Attack Power, mutually exclusive with Blessing of Might.

camp.name: Camp Chair
camp.effect: Assembles a camp chair that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 2% increased critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, mutually exclusive with Moonkin Aura.

camp.name: Faction Banner
camp.effect: Unrolls a banner that allows you and other members of the Horde sitting nearby to gain 14 (below level 40), 19 (levels 40–49), 27 (levels 50–59) or 32 (level 60+) increased Spirit, mutually exclusive with Divine Spirit.

camp.name: Faction Banner
camp.effect: Unrolls a banner that allows you and other members of the Alliance sitting nearby to gain 14 (below level 40), 19 (levels 40–49), 27 (levels 50–59) or 32 (level 60+) increased Spirit, mutually exclusive with Divine Spirit.

camp.name: Fermenter
camp.effect: Places a fermenter that allows the creation of certain reagents, and provides all of the benefits of a Mana Well.

camp.name: Anvil
camp.effect: Places an anvil, and provides all of the benefits of a Sharpening Wheel.

camp.name: Cookie's Feast
camp.effect: Lay out Cookie's Feast that contains Stamina-boosting food.

camp.name: Arcane Salvager
camp.effect: Places an Arcane Salvager that enables more efficient disenchanting, and provides all the benefits of an Enchanted Lute.

camp.name: Repair Bot
camp.effect: Summons a Repair Bot that allows you and others nearby to buy reagents and repair gear.

camp.name: Toxin Study
camp.effect: Places a Toxin Study that contains healing potions and anti-venom, and provides all of the benefits of a First Aid Kit.

camp.name: Fishing Rack
camp.effect: Places a Fishing Rack that grants the ability to catch uncommon fish for 1 hour, provides Fishing Skill lures, and provides all of the benefits of a Fish Bowl.

camp.name: Greenhouse
camp.effect: Places a Greenhouse that will grow herbs over time from seeds planted, and provides all of the benefits of an Incense Candle.

camp.name: Tanning Rack
camp.effect: Places a Tanning Rack that allows the creation of certain reagents, and provides all of the benefits of a Camp Tent.

camp.name: Rock Garden
camp.effect: Places a Rock Garden that spawns a common mining node over time, and provides all the benefits of a Lodestone.

camp.name: Field Guide
camp.effect: Places a Field Guide that allows players to read it and gain Track Beasts, and provides all the benefits of a Camp Chair.

camp.name: Spinning Wheel
camp.effect: Places a Spinning Wheel that allows the creation of certain reagents, and provides all the benefits of a Faction Banner.

camp.name: Alchemy Laboratory
camp.effect: Places an Alchemy Laboratory usable for recipes that require it, and provides all of the benefits of a Mana Well.

camp.name: Master Forge
camp.effect: Places a Master Forge usable for recipes that require it, and provides all of the benefits of a Sharpening Wheel.

camp.name: Arcane Forge
camp.effect: Places an Arcane Forge usable for recipes that require it, and provides all the benefits of an Enchanted Lute.

camp.name: Anarchist's Workbench
camp.effect: Places an Anarchist's Workbench usable for recipes that require it.

camp.name: Fishing Hut
camp.effect: Places a Fishing Hut that grants the ability to catch rare fish for 1 hour, provides Fishing Skill lures, and provides all of the benefits of a Fish Bowl.

camp.name: Seed Hybridizer
camp.effect: Places a Seed Hybridizer that allows seeds to be multiplied or combined into rarer tiers, and provides all of the benefits of an Incense Candle.

camp.name: Sewing Machine
camp.effect: Places a Sewing Machine usable for recipes that require it, and provides all of the benefits of a Camp Tent.

camp.name: Molten Foundry
camp.effect: Places a Molten Foundry usable for recipes that require it, and provides all the benefits of a Lodestone.

camp.name: Trapper's Workbench
camp.effect: Places a Trapper's Workbench containing 1 trap, and provides all the benefits of a Camp Chair.

camp.name: Iron Oven
camp.effect: Places an Iron Oven required for the most advanced cooking recipes.

camp.name: Plague Doctor's Laboratory
camp.effect: Places a Plague Doctor's Laboratory that contains healing potions and poultices, and provides all of the benefits of a First Aid Kit.

camp.name: Loom
camp.effect: Places a Loom usable for recipes that require it, and provides all the benefits of a Faction Banner.
